decisions.label: preregistered

rule1_default_judge.sign_convention: diff = candidate - jev-1.13 for both endpoints: accuracy diff > 0 is better; wrong-automatic diff < 0 is better

rule2_offline_tier.scope: local arms without a prompt intervention

rule4_interventions.confirmation_rule: targeted wrong-automatic pooled over repetitions reduced by >= 50%, accuracy down <= 2 cases, coverage down <= 10 points (per-case majority unit)

decisions.unit: per-case majority over repetitions, all manifest cases, missing/invalid rows count as fallbacks

pairwise.basis: all manifest cases, per-case majority over reps (missing/invalid rows count as fallbacks; ties toward rep 1)
